name: context-gauge
description: Model, context window and 5h/7d usage beside the Claude Code prompt: one quiet line under it in the terminal, a card above it on the desktop.

showModel.title: Show model name
showModel.description: Shown in orange. Click it to switch models.

showWeek.title: Show weekly limit (7d)
showWeek.description: How much of your weekly limit you've used.

resetShows.title: 5h reset time format
resetShows.description: How the time until your 5-hour limit resets is written.

alwaysShowReset.title: Always show 5h reset time
alwaysShowReset.description: Off: it appears only once 5h reaches the highlight level.

timeZone.title: Time zone
timeZone.description: Leave empty to use your computer's. Example: Asia/Kolkata

noticeAt.title: Highlight from (%)
noticeAt.description: Usage turns bold from this percentage.

alertAt.title: Warn from (%)
alertAt.description: Usage turns orange from this percentage.
